dct_title_s: The American atlas, or, A Geographical description of the whole continent of America : wherein are delineated at large, its several regions, countries, states and islands : and chiefly the British colonies, composed from numerous surveys, several of which were made by order of government
dct_alternative_sm: Geographical description of the whole continent of America
dct_description_sm: by Major Holland, Lewis Evans, William Scull, Henry Mouzon, Lieut. Ross, J. Cook, Michael Lane, Joseph Gilbert, Gardner, Hillock, &c. ; engraved on forty-nine copper-plates, by the late Mr. Thomas Jefferys ...

Maps: -- [1] A chart of North and South America, including the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans ... -- [2] Chart, containing the coasts of California, New Albion, and Russian discoveries to the north ... [3] Chart, containing the greater part of the South Sea ... -- [4] The Russian Discoveries ... -- [5] A new and correct map of North America, with the West India Islands ... [northern half] -- [6] [southern half] -- [7] An exact chart of the river St. Laurence ... -- [8] A chart of the Gulf of St. Laurence ... -- [9] North America from the French of Mr. D'Anville ... -- [10] A map of the British Empire, in North America -- [11] A map of the island of St. John in the Gulf of St. Laurence ... -- [12] A general chart of the island of Newfoundland ... -- [13] A chart of the banks of Newfoundland .. -- [14] A new map of Nova Scotia and Cape Breton Island and the adjacent parts of New England and Canada ... -- [15] [northern half] -- [16] A map of the most inhabited part of New England ... [southern half] -- [17] The Provinces of New York and New Jersey ... -- [18] A Survey of Lake Champlain ... -- [19] A new map of the Province of Quebec ... -- [20] A map of Pennsylvania ... -- [21] [northern half] -- [22] A map of the most inhabited part of Virginia containing the whole province of Maryland ... [southern half] -- [23] An accurate map of North and South Carolina with their Indian frontiers ... [northern half] -- [24] [southern half] -- [25] The coast of West Florida and Louisiana ... -- [26] Course of the River Mississippi ... -- [27] The Bay of Honduras -- [28] [northern part] -- [29] A map of South America ... [southern part] -- [30] A chart of the Straits of Magellan ... -- [31]
